text: Then we heard a horrible cry from the next room, a cry of pain, fear, and anger all mixed together. <break time="0.8s" /> We ran into the doctors room and found Doctor Roylott sitting in a chair, with a strange yellow band around his head. <break time="0.8s" /> The band, The speckled band, whispered Holmes, for it was a swamp adder, the deadliest snake in India. <break time="0.8s" /> The snake had bitten the doctor and killed him in seconds, and it was his own evil plan that had ended his life. <break time="0.8s" /> Holmes carefully caught the snake with the dog whip, threw it into the iron safe, and closed the heavy door. <break time="0.8s" /> Later Holmes explained that the word band had first made him think of the gypsies, which was a mistake. <break time="0.8s" /> The doctor sent the snake through the ventilator and down the rope to the bed, and he called it back with a whistle. <break time="0.8s" /> If Miss Stoner had not come to us, she would have died in exactly the same way as her sister. <break time="0.8s" /> When I hit the snake with my cane, it turned back through the ventilator and attacked its own master instead. <break time="0.8s" /> In this way I am partly responsible for his death, but I cannot say that it will trouble my conscience very much.
